blocks.title: How to read this report
blocks.intro: This is not a test with right or wrong answers. It shows what your answers say about you and what that could mean for your future. Treat it as advice, not a rule: nothing here is set in stone, and no single career or field is the only right choice. One field of study can lead to many different careers.
items: Careers that fit you: how well each one matches you, what to build, one thing to do now, and how AI may change it.
Your plan: one small step for this week, then a 90-day path.
Your profile: your interests, values, strengths and work style. This is why the careers were chosen.

items.title: Investment Banker
items.summary: Your high Enterprising, Conventional, and Investigative interests (all 100/100) suggest you would enjoy the analytical, structured, and goal-driven nature of investment banking. Your strong communication, leadership, and strategic thinking strengths (all 100/100) are also very well-suited to this field.
items.market: This career offers opportunities for significant professional growth and increasing responsibilities in the financial sector.
items.takesLabel: WHAT IT TAKES TO GET THERE
items.takes: You would need to gain formal education in finance, economics, or a related business field, and build foundational knowledge of financial markets and transactions.
items.now: You could research online for free introductory courses on corporate finance or investment banking to understand the basic concepts and daily tasks.
items.aiTitle: How AI may change this career
tasks: Basic financial modeling and valuation (creating simple models based on existing templates)
Compiling data for pitch books and client presentations
Initial market research and trend identification
Preliminary due diligence (reviewing company documents for specific red flags)
evidence: Global evidence: General industry reports indicate that AI tools are increasingly used in finance to speed up research, data analysis, and even generate preliminary reports, allowing professionals to focus on higher-level strategy and client interaction.

In your market: Financial institutions in the GCC are increasingly exploring AI for efficiency in operations and analysis, though human judgment for strategic deals and client relationships remains central.
skills: Strategic financial advisory and problem-solving for complex deals
Building and maintaining strong client relationships and trust
Negotiating complex terms and managing deal closures
Ethical judgment and compliance understanding
Innovating bespoke financial solutions for unique client needs
items.means: For someone entering this field with no work experience, understanding how to use AI tools for data analysis and research will be important. Your ability to think critically about the outputs and build strong relationships with future clients will be key. It would help to explore introductory courses in financial analysis that incorporate technology and data tools.

items.title: Lawyer
items.summary: Your top Investigative, Enterprising, and Conventional interests (all 100/100) mean you are drawn to detailed research, strategic problem-solving, and structured processes, which are core to a legal career. Your strong communication, relationships, and strategic strengths (all 100/100) would also be valuable for arguing cases and advising clients.
items.market: The legal field offers many paths for specialization and leadership, allowing for continuous intellectual challenge and influence.
items.takesLabel: WHAT IT TAKES TO GET THERE
items.takes: You would need to pursue a law degree and pass the bar examination to practice law.
items.now: You could consider finding a short, free online course that introduces legal principles or the Saudi legal system to see if the subject interests you.
items.aiTitle: How AI may change this career
tasks: Routine legal research and identifying relevant case precedents
Reviewing large volumes of documents for specific keywords or clauses
Summarizing standard contracts and legal documents
Drafting simple legal memos or initial contract templates
evidence: Global evidence: Published research and industry reports indicate that AI tools are increasingly used in legal firms to automate time-consuming tasks like document review and research, freeing lawyers for higher-value activities such as strategy and client interaction.

In your market: Legal firms in the GCC are exploring and adopting AI for efficiency in research and document handling, suggesting that entry-level roles may increasingly involve working with these tools.
skills: Providing strategic legal advice and complex problem-solving
Court advocacy and persuasive argumentation
Client counseling and understanding human situations
Ethical judgment and navigating legal complexities
Negotiating settlements and disputes effectively
items.means: As an aspiring lawyer with no work experience, your ability to think critically, understand complex information, and communicate clearly will be very valuable. It would be wise to explore how AI tools are used for legal research and document analysis, so you can focus your future efforts on legal strategy and building strong client relationships.

items.title: Military Officer

items.takesLabel: WHAT IT TAKES TO GET THERE
items.takes: To become a military officer, you would typically need to complete a bachelor's degree and then undergo officer training. It is worth noting that government hiring in Saudi Arabia is currently paused until the end of 2026, which may affect immediate recruitment.
items.now: You could research the general requirements for officer programs in the Saudi Armed Forces or National Guard to understand the educational and physical criteria for future consideration.

items.title: Real Estate Agent
items.summary: Your strong Enterprising interest (100/100) suggests you would enjoy the sales and negotiation aspects of real estate, while your high communication and relationship strengths (both 100/100) are ideal for connecting with clients. Your interest in wealth and freedom (both 100/100) also aligns well with this field.
items.market: This career offers the potential to build a strong reputation and income as you gain experience and expand your network.
items.takesLabel: WHAT IT TAKES TO GET THERE
items.takes: You would need to obtain the required real estate license and build practical experience in sales and client management.
items.now: You could attend a free introductory seminar or workshop on real estate in the GCC to learn about local market conditions and regulations.
items.aiTitle: How AI may change this career
tasks: Automated property listing data entry and updates
Initial client matching based on broad criteria
Generating basic market reports and price comparisons
Scheduling virtual property tours and automated follow-up messages
evidence: Global evidence: Industry trends show AI is helping real estate agents manage leads and analyze market data more efficiently, shifting the human role towards complex client interactions and the emotional aspects of buying or selling property.

In your market: The real estate sector in the GCC is adopting digital tools, which means agents will likely use AI for market insights and lead management, but personal trust, negotiation skills, and cultural understanding will remain central.
skills: Negotiating complex deals and closing sales effectively
Deeply understanding unspoken client needs and preferences
Building trust and long-term relationships with buyers and sellers
Providing nuanced local market insights beyond raw data
Problem-solving unique issues during property transactions
items.means: Your communication and relationship-building strengths are very important here, as buying or selling property is a significant life event for people. It would be helpful to understand how AI tools can quickly provide market data, allowing you to focus on truly understanding and meeting individual client needs and building lasting trust.

Your equally high Investigative interest (100/100) would help you analyze people's needs and provide tailored advice.

items.takesLabel: WHAT IT TAKES TO GET THERE
items.takes: You would need to complete relevant training or a degree in counseling, human resources, or psychology, and gain experience in guiding individuals.
items.now: You could look for a free online course on basic counseling skills or active listening to see if you enjoy supporting people in this way.

items.title: Life Coach
items.summary: Your excellent communication, relationships, and leadership strengths (all 100/100) are very suitable for inspiring and guiding others to achieve personal goals. Your high Enterprising interest (100/100) could also be valuable if you choose to build your own coaching practice.
items.market: This field offers flexibility and the chance to make a direct positive impact on people's lives, with potential for independent practice.
items.takesLabel: WHAT IT TAKES TO GET THERE
items.takes: You would need to complete a coaching certification program and build practical experience in guiding clients.
items.now: A good step would be to read books or free online resources about life coaching to understand its principles and methods.
items.aiTitle: How AI may change this career
tasks: Scheduling appointments and sending reminder messages
Tracking client progress on basic, quantifiable metrics
Providing general information or resources based on keywords
Managing administrative aspects of a coaching practice
evidence: Global evidence: General industry observations show that while AI can provide information or basic advice, the deeply personal and trust-based relationship in coaching, which involves emotional intelligence and nuanced human interaction, requires human presence.

In your market: Life coaching in the GCC relies heavily on personal connection, cultural understanding, and trust, making it a role where AI will primarily serve as an administrative or information-gathering assistant rather than a core coach.
skills: Active listening and empathetic understanding of client emotions
Building deep rapport and trust with clients
Inspiring personal growth and guiding self-discovery
Understanding complex human motivations and behaviors
Applying ethical considerations in personal development and sensitive conversations
items.means: Your strengths in relationships and communication are exactly what will make you effective as a life coach, as AI cannot replicate genuine empathy or human connection. You could consider how technology might help with organizational tasks, allowing you to focus more of your time and energy on direct client engagement and support.

Your high Enterprising and Investigative interests (both 100/100) would also help in developing effective training strategies and leading teams.

items.takesLabel: WHAT IT TAKES TO GET THERE
items.takes: You would need to acquire specific coaching certifications for your chosen sport and gain practical experience in coaching or training athletes.
items.now: You could volunteer to assist a local sports team or community fitness group to gain some initial experience in a coaching setting.
items.aiTitle: How AI may change this career
tasks: Routine scheduling of training sessions
Compiling player statistics and basic performance metrics
Tracking attendance and administrative tasks
Generating generic workout plans based on standard templates
evidence: Global evidence: While AI can analyze performance data and suggest training plans, the core role of a coach in inspiring and guiding individuals, understanding their emotions, and building trust remains deeply human.
In your market: Sports coaching in the GCC is likely to see AI as a supportive tool for analytics and administrative tasks rather than a replacement for direct interaction and personal guidance.
skills: Motivating and inspiring athletes through personal connection
Building team cohesion and individual rapport
Providing personalized feedback and emotional support
Adapting strategies in real-time during games or training based on human observation
Understanding individual athlete psychology and well-being
items.means: As you look to enter this field, your natural strengths in relationships, communication, and leadership are very valuable because AI cannot replicate these human connections. You could consider how you might use data tools to support your coaching activities without losing the personal connection with athletes.

items.summary: Your excellent communication, relationships, and execution strengths (all 100/100) mean you are well-suited to guiding individuals through personalized fitness programs. Your high Enterprising interest (100/100) would also be helpful for managing clients or potentially building your own training business.

blocks.t: One small step for this week, then a simple 90-day path, built around your top career match
Built around your top match: Investment Banker
Your first step this week

A good first step is to read three job descriptions for entry-level roles as a Junior Investment Banker or Junior Lawyer in Saudi Arabia or another GCC country like the UAE. Why: This will help you understand the daily tasks, required skills, and work environments for careers that match your Enterprising, Conventional, and Investigative interests, and your desire for a strong Reputation.
YOU WILL PRODUCE
A short list of common responsibilities and required skills that you found interesting from each job description.
WHEN
Within 2 days, about 1 hour
Worksheet:
Days 2–7

Days 2-3 — We suggest you identify two people currently working as an Investment Banker or a Lawyer in the GCC through online professional platforms. Look for profiles that share aspects of your background. You will produce: A list with their names, current roles, and one question you would like to ask them about their work.

Day 4 — You could draft a short, polite message to one of these professionals asking for a brief conversation about their career path. Remember to explain why you are reaching out. You will produce: A draft message ready to send.

Days 5-6 — It would help to research what kind of educational background (degree types, specific certifications) is commonly mentioned for Investment Banker or Lawyer roles in the GCC. Compare this with what you learned from the job descriptions. You will produce: A short comparison table of typical educational paths versus job description requirements.

Day 7 — A good way to end the week is to review what you produced and pick the next step you feel most comfortable taking, based on your discoveries. You will produce: A note outlining your chosen next step and why.
Your next 90 days

Weeks 2–4 — Build momentum We suggest you look for a free online course that gives an introduction to basic financial concepts or legal principles. This would help you test your interest in fields like Investment Banking or Law.
It would be beneficial to attend an online webinar or virtual career fair focused on the finance or legal sector in the GCC. Many organizations offer these for free.
You could also reach out to a career counselor or professional mentor who works with individuals looking to enter these sectors in Saudi Arabia.

Months 2–3 — Build A good next step would be to apply for short-term internships or volunteer positions within a financial institution or a law firm. This would give you hands-on experience and help you decide if a career in Investment Banking or Law is the right fit.
We advise you to consider enrolling in a short beginner course in financial analysis or legal studies. This would help build foundational knowledge relevant to Investment Banker or Lawyer roles.
It would be helpful to connect with more professionals in your target fields, perhaps through informational interviews, to learn about their daily work and career progression.
Your skills to build and practice exercise: Investment Banker
SKILLS TO BUILD

Critical evaluation of AI-generated financial insights — AI tools can quickly process large amounts of financial data and suggest trends or valuations, but a human touch is needed to check if these insights make sense and fit the real-world situation.

Clear and persuasive communication of complex financial information — Even if AI helps with analysis, presenting detailed financial ideas simply and convincingly to clients or colleagues still requires strong human communication and understanding of your audience.
PRACTICE EXERCISE

A good exercise would be to find a recent public financial report for a well-known company (for example, on their investor relations website). You could then ask a free AI tool to summarize the report and identify key financial risks or opportunities. After reviewing the AI's output, you could write a short memo (about 300-400 words) explaining the company's financial health, critically assessing the AI's points, and adding your own thoughts on any significant concerns or upsides the AI might have missed.
YOU WILL HAVE

You will have a copy of the original financial report, the AI-generated summary, and your own critical memo that shows your analysis and communication skills. Your memo would highlight where the AI was helpful and where your human judgment added more value.

Your strengths in communication, relationships, and leadership are valuable foundations for many professional paths in the GCC. This balanced approach focuses on building general professional skills that can lead to roles like a Real Estate Agent or a Life Coach, while keeping your options open for other opportunities that align with your values of reputation, freedom, and family.
Taking a short beginner course in professional communication or negotiation skills could be beneficial to enhance your natural strengths in relationships and communication.

Exploring volunteer positions or entry-level internships in administrative or client-facing roles within a business in the GCC could provide valuable practical experience and insight into different industries.
Completing the necessary licensing course to become a Real Estate Agent in Saudi Arabia could be a direct way to enter a field that aligns with your desire for freedom and good reputation.

intro: Courses that build the skills your matched careers need. These are for later: use them as a guide when you are ready, not something to do all at once.

items.title: Financial Modeling & Valuation Analyst (FMVA)
items.about: What it is about: This certification covers financial modeling, Excel skills, and valuation methods.
items.why: These skills are central to understanding company value and financial planning in investment banking.

items.title: Islamic Finance and Banking
items.about: What it is about: This course explains the basics of banking and financial tools that follow Islamic law.
items.why: Learning about Shariah-compliant finance is especially helpful for banking in Saudi Arabia.

items.title: Real Estate Finance and Investment
items.about: What it is about: This course teaches how to value, finance, and analyze investments in real estate.
items.why: Understanding real estate value and finance is key for advising clients as an agent.

items.title: Negotiation Mastery
items.about: What it is about: This course provides practical ways to negotiate and resolve disagreements.
items.why: Real estate agents often negotiate prices and terms for their clients every day.

items.title: Contract Law
items.about: What it is about: This course covers the main ideas of how contracts are made, enforced, and broken.
items.why: A lawyer constantly works with contracts, making this knowledge very important for daily tasks.

items.title: Compliance and Risk Management
items.about: What it is about: This course focuses on rules for companies, how to check for risks, and legal standards.
items.why: Lawyers often advise businesses on following rules and managing legal risks.

items.title: Emotional Intelligence
items.about: What it is about: This course helps you build self-awareness, empathy, and skills to manage relationships.
items.why: A life coach uses emotional intelligence to understand clients and help them grow personally.

items.title: Mental Health First Aid
items.about: What it is about: This course teaches you to recognize and respond to mental health challenges.
items.why: A life coach might meet clients with mental health concerns, so knowing how to help is useful.

blocks.t: John, your unique blend of interests in leading, organizing, and investigating, along with your high value for Reputation and strength in Relationships, gives you a strong foundation. You are well-positioned to consider careers that allow you to engage with people, solve complex problems, and build a respected professional standing. By focusing on your desire for Freedom and using your communication skills, you can find a path that is truly rewarding for you.
